{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for SEVERE disease and valid baseline biomarker values
# Exclude -999.0 as sentinel for missing data
severe_df = df[(df['severity'] == 'severe') & (df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0)]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_biomarker = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker"}
